enchantments.tooltip: +13 Enhancement Bonus: +13 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Insightful Armor-Piercing 10%: Passive: +10% Insight bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Electrifying 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 6d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Jolting 14: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 14d6 Lightning damage on each critical hit.
Insightful Distant Diversion +9%: +9% Insight bonus to decreased threat generated from ranged damage.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
